plugins/voletautobe/desktop/php/voletaut.Aucun groupe pour le moment. Pour démarr: No group yet. To get started:
plugins/voletautobe/desktop/php/voletaut.Ces commandes sont créées et tenues à jo: These commands are created and kept up to date by the plugin. « Next change » belongs on a dashboard, « Open », « Close » and « Stop » act on the whole group, « Position » moves it to a given height, and « State » gives the group's position — 0 % closed, 100 % open.
plugins/voletautobe/desktop/php/voletaut.Cette orientation sert deux fois dans l': This orientation serves twice in the « Schedule » tab: it triggers the moments set on « when the sun reaches the facade » or « when it leaves it », and it fixes the window of the sun condition. One group per facade is therefore the right way to cut up the house. The previews, for their part, are computed on the saved facade: save to see them follow.
plugins/voletautobe/desktop/php/voletaut.Cliquez sur « Ajouter un groupe » et don: Click on « Add a group » and give it a name, for instance « Bedrooms » or « South facade ».
plugins/voletautobe/desktop/php/voletaut.Cliquez sur « Choisir les volets » : le: Click on « Choose the shutters »: the plugin finds them in your installation, you only tick. The buttons on each line open or close the shutter, which is the only way to find out which one is « Module 3 ».

plugins/voletautobe/desktop/php/voletaut.Fermer aux trois quarts quand le soleil: Closing three quarters of the way when the sun reaches the facade, on hot days only, and doing nothing the rest of the year: it is the moment that justifies the temperature sensor on its own. Closing at a fixed time suited June, let the sun beat down an hour too long in August and meant nothing at all in October; the facade, for its part, follows the seasons by itself.

Closing three quarters of the way when the sun reaches the facade, on hot days only, and doing nothing the rest of the year: it is the moment that justifies the temperature sensor on its own. Closing at a fixed time suited June, let the sun beat down an hour too long in August and meant nothing at all in October; the facade, for its part, follows the seasons by itself.
plugins/voletautobe/desktop/php/voletaut.L'autre condition qui peut empêcher ce m: The other condition that can prevent this moment, and the one that makes the sun protection right: do nothing as long as the sun is not on the group facade. It serves above all the moments triggered at a fixed time — « at 13:00, only if the sun is on the facade ». On a moment already triggered by the facade, it only checks the elevation any more, which is said just below. The plugin knows where the sun is, not whether it shines: on an overcast day the moment is played anyway — as it is if the installation position is not set.
plugins/voletautobe/desktop/php/voletaut.L'azimut où le soleil abandonne cette fa: The azimuth at which the sun leaves this facade. The range may pass through the north: « from 300° to 30° » is a north-west–north-east facade, and it does contain 350°. Two identical values make an empty facade: the sun would never be on it, and the sun condition would prevent the moment every day.
plugins/voletautobe/desktop/php/voletaut.L'azimut où le soleil apparaît sur cette: The azimuth at which the sun comes onto this facade: the direction it comes from, counted from the north, 90° east, 180° due south, 270° west. A due south facade sees the sun from 135° (south-east) to 315° (north-west). No compass? Open this page at the precise moment the sun reaches the facade and copy here the azimuth shown below; do it again in the evening, when it leaves it, for the other value.
plugins/voletautobe/desktop/php/voletaut.L'essai commande réellement les volets e: The test really commands the saved shutters: save first if you have just changed the selection.
plugins/voletautobe/desktop/php/voletaut.La condition qui peut empêcher ce moment: The condition that can hold this moment back. In winter, a closed shutter insulates: opening it at 7 am at −3 °C loses heat for three hours of grey light. In summer, you only close at midday on the days when it is really hot. If the sensor does not answer, the moment is played anyway: a broken sensor must not leave the house with its shutters closed.
plugins/voletautobe/desktop/php/voletaut.La hauteur du soleil au-dessus de l'hori: The elevation of the sun above the horizon below which it no longer heats this facade. Without it, a December day when the sun grazes at 8° would fire a sun protection that makes no sense: the direction is right, but the sun passes behind the houses opposite. 15° is a good starting point; raise the value if a tree or a wall already protects you early in the day.
plugins/voletautobe/desktop/php/voletaut.La position de votre installation n'est: The position of your installation is not set: sunrise and sunset times would be wrong. Set it in Settings → System → Configuration → General.
plugins/voletautobe/desktop/php/voletaut.La position de votre installation n\\'es: The position of your installation is not set: sunrise and sunset times would be wrong. Set it in Settings → System → Configuration → General.
plugins/voletautobe/desktop/php/voletaut.La position du soleil maintenant, calcul: The position of the sun right now, computed from the position of your installation. Open this page at the moment the sun reaches the facade: the azimuth shown here is the one to copy above.
plugins/voletautobe/desktop/php/voletaut.Le coucher du soleil varie de 16 h 40 en: Sunset ranges from 4:40 pm in December to 10:00 pm in June: closing the shutters at 4:40 pm is too early. A time guard brings the moment back into the window, it does not cancel it — « not before 18:00 » closes at 18:00 on the evenings when the sun sets earlier. Leave empty to follow the sun all year.
plugins/voletautobe/desktop/php/voletaut.Le moment où l'on ferme pour la nuit : l: The moment you close for the night: most often at sunset, with « not before 18:00 » — in December the sun sets at 4:40 pm, and closing at 4:40 pm is too early.
plugins/voletautobe/desktop/php/voletaut.Le moment où l'on veut de la lumière : a: The moment you want light: at sunrise, or at a fixed time. In winter, « only if it is at least 2 °C » keeps the shutters closed on frosty mornings, when they insulate more than they let light in.

plugins/voletautobe/desktop/php/voletaut.Rouvrir quand le soleil quitte la façade: Opening again when the sun leaves the facade. Without this moment, the shutters closed at midday stay closed until the evening and the room stays dark for nothing, when there is nothing left to protect. It asks for no sun condition: at the instant it fires, the sun has just left the facade.

plugins/voletautobe/desktop/php/voletaut.Simulation de présence : le moment est a: Presence simulation: the moment is moved earlier or later at random, within this limit. The draw happens once a day, so the time announced is the one that will really be played.
plugins/voletautobe/desktop/php/voletaut.Suspendre arrête les quatre moments sans: Pause stops the four moments without disabling the group: the buttons go on working, the group stays on the dashboard, and the « Pause » and « Resume » commands can be driven from a scenario — a holiday mode, shutters left open for the painters.
plugins/voletautobe/desktop/php/voletaut.Une maison a une température extérieure,: A house has one outdoor temperature, not eight: leave « The plugin's one » and set it once in the configuration. A group that deserves its own sensor — the north-facing bedroom, a conservatory — picks its own here. With no readable sensor, the temperature conditions of the Schedule tab have no effect: the moments are played anyway.

plugins/voletautobe/plugin_info/configur.La sonde que tous les groupes utilisent,: The sensor every group uses, except those that choose another one. A house has one outdoor temperature, not eight: setting it here saves you from choosing it group by group, and from correcting it everywhere the day you change weather station.
plugins/voletautobe/plugin_info/configur.Minutes pendant lesquelles un moment man: Minutes during which a missed moment is still played — box switched off, reboot, late cron. After that it is dropped: opening the morning shutters at noon helps nobody. 15 minutes suit almost every case.
plugins/voletautobe/plugin_info/configur.Sans sonde lisible, les conditions de te: With no readable sensor, the temperature conditions have no effect: the plugin moves the shutters anyway. That is deliberate — a broken sensor must not leave the house with its shutters closed for ever — but it is worth knowing.
